title: FinFraudBench: A Heterogeneous Graph Benchmark for Financial Fraud Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.15177v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The increasing complexity of digital financial systems has reshaped financial fraud detection from isolated transaction classification into relational risk reasoning over interconnected financial entities. This shift has motivated graph-based fraud detection, where models identify fraudulent nodes by exploiting dependencies among customers, cards, merchants, categories, and locations. However, despite rapid progress in graph-based methods, existing public benchmarks remain misaligned with real-world financial systems in two important aspects. First, they often simplify financial ecosystems into homogeneous or single-node-type multi-relational graphs, failing to preserve the multi-entity and multi-relational nature of financial data. translated_title: FinFraudBench：面向金融欺诈检测的异构图基准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15177v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：数字金融系统日益复杂的特性，已将金融欺诈检测从孤立的交易分类重塑为对相互关联金融实体间的关系风险推理。这一转变推动了基于图的欺诈检测方法的发展，其中模型通过利用客户、卡片、商户、类别和地点之间的依赖关系来识别欺诈节点。然而，尽管基于图的方法取得了快速进展，现有公开基准在两个方面与现实金融系统存在偏差。首先，它们通常将金融生态系统简化为同质或单节点类型的多关系图，未能保留金融数据的多实体和多关系特性。其次，它们很少提供具有现实运行条件（如极端类别不平衡和有限标签可用性）的大规模异构金融图数据集，这使得评估变得困难。
tldr: 本文提出了FinFraudBench，一个大规模异构金融图基准，旨在解决现有基准在保留多实体多关系特性和模拟现实运行条件（如极端类别不平衡和标签稀缺）方面的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces FinFraudBench, a large-scale heterogeneous financial graph benchmark that addresses the limitations of existing benchmarks in preserving multi-entity multi-relational characteristics and simulating realistic operating conditions such as extreme class imbalance and label scarcity.
